title: one-off-coverage-scratchpad-and-crosswalk-jun-2026
content:
PURPOSE: quick one-off tracker to map weekend/surge coverage gaps across teams for the June 2026 traffic spike. Lightweight spreadsheet for rapid handoffs; meant to be copyable into other docs and used as an async source-of-truth during the 2-week window.

INSTRUCTIONS:
- Owners fill 'Current Capacity' and 'On-call overlap' by EOD.
- Mark rows with RED if there is < 0.5 FTE overlap or no escalation path.
- Use 'Next action' field to capture immediate asks (tag Slack: #ops-coverage).

SUMMARY SNAP (2026-06-17):
- Total owners listed: 14 (9 have on-call overlap >= 1hr).
- Flagged risky buckets: 3 (data-sync, regional-fallback, stream.generate).
- Quick recommendation: provision 1 temporary SRE rotation for weekend Jun19-20, and enable fallback model variant in ap-south region.

SHEET GRID (columns):
Owner | Role | Primary contact (email) | Coverage window (local) | Timezone | Escalation path (primary -> secondary) | Current capacity (FTE equiv) | On-call overlap (hrs) | Dependencies | Notes (scratch) | Next action | Last update

Rows:
1) Jamie Chen | Product Ops | jamie.chen@redwood.ai | 09:00-18:00 | PDT | oncall-sre -> eng-patch | 0.4 | 2 | infra-burst, endpoint-throttle | running lightweight sampling tomorrow; needs API token refresh | Ask SRE to extend token by 48h; cc @Ayesha | 2026-06-17

2) Ayesha Malik | Solutions Eng | ayesha.malik@redwood.ai | 08:00-16:00 | PDT | se-oncall -> se-backup | 0.6 | 1.5 | customer-fallthrough, fallback-models | can own customer-facing reroutes; limited weekend coverage | Confirm re-route playbook with SE-runbook | 2026-06-16

3) Carlos Rivera | Site Reliability | carlos.rivera@redwood.ai | 24/7 (rotating) | UTC-7 | srewave -> srewave-backup | 1.0 | 8 | autoscaler, gpu-pool-dedicated | rotation heavy; has capacity to pick up one extra short shift | Confirm availability for Jun19 night shift | 2026-06-15

4) Marta Petrova | Serving Runtime | marta.petrova@redwood.ai | 10:00-19:00 | CEST | runtime-oncall -> runtime-lead | 0.3 | 0.5 | kernel-chooser, quant-pilot | concerned about seq-len regression on new kernels | Add kernel roll-back checkbox to rollout | 2026-06-17

5) Noah Singh | Console & Rollouts | noah.singh@redwood.ai | 09:30-17:30 | EDT | console-oncall -> product-ops | 0.25 | 0 | dashboard-readonly; no weekend badge | Can run manual toggle for canary but no weekend on-call | Request weekend toggle permission for Noah (temp) | 2026-06-16

6) Priya Iyer | Dedicated Capacity | priya.iyer@redwood.ai | 07:00-15:00 | IST | dedicated-ops -> infra-lead | 0.5 | 1 | reserved-pools, region-fallback | Can spin up one extra node but lead needs signoff | Get finance pre-OK for 48h burst | 2026-06-14

7) Lukas Meyer | Private Deployments | lukas.meyer@redwood.ai | 08:00-17:00 | CET | private-oncall -> sec-team | 0.2 | 0 | kms, hsm | not in scope for hosted API incidents | Confirm isolation requirements; no action this weekend | 2026-06-10

8) Emily Park | Observability | emily.park@redwood.ai | 09:00-18:00 | PDT | observ-oncall -> observ-backup | 0.5 | 2 | tracer, per-route dashboards | will enable trace sampling increase for Jun19-20 | Create quick alert rule for stream.generate spike | 2026-06-16

9) Ben Okoro | Developer Experience | ben.okoro@redwood.ai | 10:00-18:00 | GMT | dx-oncall -> dx-backup | 0.15 | 0 | sdks, quickstarts | can publish a short note to docs for workaround | Draft small doc and push to support-docs | 2026-06-15

10) Sofia Alvarez | Product Hosted API | sofia.alvarez@redwood.ai | 08:00-17:00 | PST | hosted-api-oncall -> api-lead | 0.75 | 3 | model-routing, quotas | primary owner for stream.generate routing; flagged | Run quota-minute test on Jun18; assess fallback coverage | 2026-06-17

11) Theo Laurent | Platform Engineering | theo.laurent@redwood.ai | 09:00-17:00 | CET | platform-oncall -> infra-lead | 0.35 | 1 | k8s-node-pools, autoscaler | can increase pod limit by 20% for short window | Approve pod limit bump; notify SRE | 2026-06-13

12) Riya Patel | Customer Success | riya.patel@redwood.ai | 07:30-16:30 | IST | cs-oncall -> se-oncall | 0.3 | 0 | customer-escrows, contract-SLAs | customer A expecting degraded perf; needs heads-up | Send proactive note to key customers | 2026-06-15

13) Omar Haddad | Security & Compliance | omar.haddad@redwood.ai | 09:00-18:00 | EET | sec-oncall -> sec-backup | 0.2 | 0 | audit-logs, kms | weekend change window requires sec approval | Fast-track low-risk ops-only actions | 2026-06-12

14) Mei Lin | Solutions Eng (APAC) | mei.lin@redwood.ai | 10:00-19:00 | SGT | se-apac -> se-global | 0.4 | 2 | regional-fallback, edge-cache | good overlap for APAC region | Coordinate ap-south fallback trigger with Priya | 2026-06-16

ANALYSIS NOTES (scratch):
- Immediate gaps: Noah (console) + Ben (DX) have zero overlap for weekend; these are lower-risk but useful for docs/toggles.
- High-risk: stream.generate endpoint relies on Sofia + Carlos + Emily; if all three are out at same time, fallback relies on quantized model from Priya (needs node).
- Regional concern: AP-South fallback currently manual; need automation or a paired on-call.

ACTIONS (short list):
- ACTION-1: Assign temporary weekend SRE backup (Jun19-20) - owner: Carlos (status: PENDING).
- ACTION-2: Grant Noah weekend toggle permission (Product Ops) - owner: Jamie (status: PENDING).
- ACTION-3: Finance pre-approve 48h node burst for Priya (status: REQUESTED).
- ACTION-4: Add trace alert for stream.generate spike to Emily (status: DONE).

OPEN QUESTIONS / DECISIONS NEEDED:
- Do we automatically trigger ap-south fallback at 60% latency increase? (Yes/No).
- Is a paid burst acceptable for customers with reserved pools? (Finance)

NOTES TO SELF:
- Keep this sheet minimal — prefer pointers into runbooks rather than long SOPs.
- After Jun20: convert to post-mortem template (owner: Jamie).

SNIPPET: quick command for on-call to toggle fallback (for docs)
- toggle-fallback --region ap-south --variant quant-small --reason "weekend spike Jun19"

Last edited by: Jamie Chen on 2026-06-17; small edits to capacity numbers after sync with SRE.
